process.title:
From hello
to forever.
process.body: Four steps, designed with intentionality, because finding a partner deserves more than an algorithm.

create.b: Build a detailed profile that reflects who you truly are, then earn your verified badge with a live selfie.

discover.b: Our matching engine scores compatible profiles on age, location, education, lifestyle and family preferences. You stay in full control of who sees you.

connect.b: Every conversation is encrypted in transit and stays private. Express interest, chat, and bring family in when ready.

journey.b: Take your time to talk, bring your family in, and meet somewhere public when you are ready.

cities.body: Tap a city to explore. Mass-market apps don't understand what matters here: shared roots, family values, the comfort of proximity.

faq.title:
Questions?
We've got answers.
faq.body: If you don't find what you need, reach out. We respond within 24 hours, in English, Hindi or Punjabi.

residents.a: Yes. Every profile is from Chandigarh, Mohali, or Panchkula, or has direct family ties to the region. Hyperlocal is the point.

verification.a: Members submit a live selfie, captured in the moment and never uploaded from files, that our team matches against their profile photos. The verified badge appears once approved.

browse.q: Can I browse without an account?
browse.a: No, search and full profiles need a free account. Creating one takes about two minutes and you can start browsing right away.

nri.q: I live abroad, can NRIs join?
nri.a: Yes, if you are from the Tricity or your family is. Where you live now does not matter; the roots do. Mark yourself as an NRI during sign-up and add your country, and families looking for an NRI alliance will see it. A parent or sibling here can search alongside you through Guardian access.

premium.a: One plan, no tiers to compare: unlimited contact unlocks, unlimited messaging, advanced filters, Incognito mode, a profile boost and a spotlight listing, for the full term. Browsing, matching and your profile stay free.

privacy.a: Yes. Conversations are encrypted in transit and access is restricted to you and your match. We never share your phone number, never sell data, never display you to non-mutual interests.

families.a: Yes, gracefully. You choose when. They get their own view and chat channel kept respectfully separate from yours.
